strings.name: David Vélez
strings.summary: Colombian-born Vélez worked in investment banking and venture capital before founding Nubank in Brazil with Cristina Junqueira and Edward Wible. He expanded mobile financial services across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia and into the US in 2026. US products use a partner bank; this does not mean its own bank charter is fully approved.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Nubank, advancing digital banking and fintech innovation in Latin America and expanding the use of online financial services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Stanford BS in Management Science and Engineering; MBA
strings.highlights.h1.title: Developing Latin American digital finance
strings.highlights.h1.text: With his cofounders, he built Nubank to deliver cards, accounts and other services digitally.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Entering the US market
strings.highlights.h2.text: US products launched through a partner bank in 2026; permission to establish its own US bank remained conditional.
strings.timeline.t1.title: US business launch
strings.timeline.t1.text: Nu introduced US products and Nu Global; US deposits are held by partner Lead Bank.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joining OpenAI boards
strings.timeline.t2.text: Appointed to the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Conditional US approval
strings.timeline.t3.text: The OCC gave preliminary conditional approval to establish Nubank N.A., subject to conditions and other regulatory requirements.
strings.timeline.t4.title: New York Stock Exchange listing
strings.timeline.t4.text: Nu completed its initial public offering, broadening its funding channels.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Expansion into Mexico
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company started Mexican operations, followed by Colombia in 2021.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Cofounding Nubank
strings.timeline.t6.text: With Junqueira and Wible, he established the digital-finance company in Brazil.
strings.timeline.t7.title: MBA completed
strings.timeline.t7.text: He earned a Stanford MBA; before founding Nubank he managed Latin American investments at Sequoia.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Undergraduate degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: He graduated in Management Science and Engineering from Stanford before working in financial investment.
